raw_feedback_text: Issue - Valve was added on the Header line, but a Base Structure (GS-SB) was not provided. When a Valve or a component that cannot bear roller contact is provided on header line, a Base Structure need to be provided. This is compulsory. Looks like EDAS was not followed

structured_feedback.affected_requirement: Protect header components that cannot bear roller contact
structured_feedback.affected_function: support and protect the header valve during roller contact
structured_feedback.affected_constraint: A header valve or other component unable to bear roller contact requires a GD-SB.
structured_feedback.pmap_issue: The concept placed a valve on the header without the compulsory GD-SB, contrary to the EDAS rule.
